answer_1.quote: WebMMU covers three core tasks: Website VQA (WebQA), Mockup2Code Generation, assessing design‑to‑code alignment for UI mockups and sketches, and Web Code Editing, evaluating precise, context‑aware HTML/CSS/JavaScript code editing for feature additions, UI tweaks, and bug fixes.
answer_1.outputs: generated text answers for VQA, HTML/CSS/JS code snippets, code diffs/patches

answer_2.quote: Evaluation combines LLM-as-Judge scoring with established automatic metrics, as summarized in Table ...; we also report BLEU, TreeBLEU, Spearman and Pearson correlations for code generation tasks.

answer_3.quote: For all LLM-as-Judge evaluations, we use GPT4o-1120, which has demonstrated strong alignment with human judgment and diverse scoring behavior, ensuring robustness across tasks.
methods: 1-5 rating scale for layout and functional accuracy

answer_4.quote: We sampled 100 examples per task and enlisted PhD students and researchers as annotators to evaluate alignment between human judgments and the automatic metric (LLM judge).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared model outputs to reference answers and judged correctness, functional relevance, and spatial grounding according to defined criteria.
